summary: Specifies the Media Resource Control Protocol Version 2 (MRCPv2), which lets client hosts control media service resources such as speech synthesizers, recognizers, verifiers, and identifiers located in servers on the network. It is not a stand-alone protocol and relies on other protocols such as SIP. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: It is a remote control for talking machines. A program can tell a server to read text aloud or to listen and work out what someone said.

questions: how to control speech recognition servers
